entities.name: Josua Maaler
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Josua Maaler 
was a Swiss pastor and lexicographer. He was the author of the first dictionary which focused exclusively on the German language, published in Zürich as Die Teütsch Spraach in 1561.
